name: Unleash AI – Bulk Generate SEO Title, Description and Alt Text using AI
author: Unleash AI

sections.description:
AI for SEO: Generate Meta Titles & Descriptions: With Unleash AI, creating meta titles and descriptions using AI for your pages or posts need only few mins instead of hours. Simply click “Generate,” and the plugin will provide three SEO optimized versions of both titles and descriptions. Choose the one you love and enhance your website’s SEO in seconds!

Generate Image Alt Text using AI: Generate AI-driven alt text for images across your site to improve accessibility and SEO. The bulk editing feature allows you to update alt text for multiple pages with a single click.

Smart Keyword Integration: Our AI is designed to analyze your page copy and identify the most effective keywords to target. It seamlessly optimizes your meta tags to be both keyword-rich and naturally appealing, boosting your website’s visibility on search engines with ease.

Optimized for WordPress SEO: Unleash AI is built to work seamlessly with WordPress, including WooCommerce, providing optimal meta information that boosts your search engine rankings.

Using ChatGPT and Gemini AI Models: We are using ChatGPT and Gemini models to bring out the best for you. We switch one model to another based on AI model responses you love the most.

Bulk Generate and Update: Save time with our bulk editing features. Effortlessly generate, update or modify meta titles, descriptions, and alt text for multiple pages and images at once.

Review and Edit Features: Preview all generated meta information and alt text before they go live, with the option to make manual edits for a personalized touch.

Works with your SEO plugin: Unleash AI plugin works with popular SEO plugins like YOAST, RankMath, All in one SEO and SEO Framework. It adds title and description directly in your plugin.

This plugin integrates with UnleashAI.co APIs to generate meta title, description and alt text.

External Services

This plugin integrates with UnleashAI.co APIs to generate meta title, description and alt text. If you are an agency and want to manage meta title, description and lat text of multiple sites from a single place, please to login to our web dashboard.
sections.installation:
How to Activate Your Plugin

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin area (wp-admin).
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “Unleash AI”.
  4. Install and activate the Unleash AI plugin from your Plugins page.
  5. Click on Unleash AI in the sidebar menu, then select Sign Up or Sign In to activate your license.
  6. Log in using your Unleash AI Username and Password.
  7. Your license is now activated.

How to Connect Multiple Websites with Unleash AI’s Web Dashboard

  1. Complete the plugin activation process on each site you want to manage.
  2. Log in to the web dashboard at https://unleashai.co/auth/login and navigate to the Manage Site section.
  3. Enter your website address and secret key (you can find the secret key under the Account Settings page in the Unleash AI plugin on your site).
  4. Click the Connect Site button.
  5. Your site is now connected to Unleash AI and ready to generate metadata and alt text.
  6. You can now use the web dashboard to:
    • Generate titles, descriptions, and alt text.
    • Switch between connected sites seamlessly.

Updating

Automatic updates should work smoothly, but we still recommend you back up your site.
sections.faq:
How does Unleash AI integrate with my SEO plugins?

Unleash AI offers a WordPress plugin that seamlessly integrates with popular SEO plugins like All in One SEO, Rank Math, Yoast, and SEOPress, allowing users to automate or manually customize meta information and alt tags. Generated title and descriptions will directly update in your installed plugin.

What features does Unleash AI provide?

Key features include automatic generation of meta titles and descriptions, and alt tags for images. Users can define focus keywords or let the AI suggest the best-suited keywords based on content.

Is there a free plan available?

Yes, Unleash AI offers a “Forever Free Plan” suitable for small sites. You get 200 credits free each month. 1 Credit = 1 title/description/alt text generation.

How can I contact Unleash AI for support or inquiries?

For support, you can email support@unleashai.co. For marketing inquiries, contact marketing@unleashai.co, and for business-related questions, reach out to business@unleashai.co. Unleash AI

Who are the founders of Unleash AI?

Unleash AI was co-founded by Saurabh Srivastava, a marketing professional, and Siva Teja, a Machine Learning Engineer, who met on Reddit and collaborated to create the platform. Unleash AI

How can I reset my Unleash AI account password?

If you’ve forgotten your password, you can request a reset link by entering your email on the password reset page. If you don’t see the email in your inbox, check your spam or junk folder. Unleash AI

Does Unleash AI offer support for multiple websites?

Yes, Unleash AI allows users to connect multiple sites and manage them all from a single dashboard.
